integrity: Analytic rooted-forest proof; independent standard-library exact enumeration for finite sizes, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled unrooted trees only; exact conditional finite law. Earlier marginal mean and path-attachment generating-function results are prior work, not claimed new; general enumeration may permit earlier indirect derivations.
source_ids: Berkeley Statistics Technical Report 526 (Aldous--Pitman; catalog date 1998-06-01)
title: Conditional joint leaf law along a marked path in a uniform Cayley tree
